2607.29577.title: DungeonBench: A Benchmark for Rules-Rich Tactical Reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons Combat
2607.29577.paper_summary: Games and simulators make valuable benchmarks by turning decisions into measurable outcomes, but many current suites under-test rules-rich tactical reasoning: the ability to choose well when geometry, timing, resources, objectives, and rule interactions all matter at once. We introduce DungeonBench, a benchmark for tactical reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons combat, built to cover the vast majority of combat-relevant 2014 System Reference Document content whose effects can be resolved by the simulator while retaining mechanics that simplified combat simulators often abstract away. At each step, DungeonBench exposes a complete tactical observation, a pending decision, and an indexed list of executable options spanning movement, attacks, spells, reactions, objectives, preparation, and scarce resources. The task is to value legal choices whose consequences depend on action economy, creature traits, battlefield geometry, timing windows, and future encounters. DungeonBench has two tracks: Encounter, which evaluates local tactical play in single fights, and Day, which links encounters through persistent hit points, spell slots, consumables, preparation, and short-rest timing, forcing policies to trade off immediate tactical advantage against future survivability. The same engine-generated decision stream supports heuristic controllers, language-model policies, learned option rankers, and masked-action reinforcement-learning agents. We evaluate frontier language-model policies on this shared decision stream. Results show that full tactical observations do not saturate the benchmark: frontier policies often win direct encounters, but linked encounter days expose failures in resource budgeting, rest timing, and rule-aware tactical discipline.
2607.29577.paper_summary_zh: 遊戲和模擬器通過將決策轉化為可衡量的結果來提供有價值的基準，但許多當前的套件在測試規則豐富的戰術推理方面不足：當幾何、時機、資源、目標和規則互動同時重要時，選擇正確的能力。我們介紹DungeonBench，這是一個針對《龍與地下城》戰鬥中的戰術推理的基準，旨在涵蓋2014年系統參考文件中絕大多數與戰鬥相關的內容，其效果可以通過模擬器解決，同時保留簡化戰鬥模擬器經常抽象掉的機制。在每一步中，DungeonBench揭示了完整的戰術觀察、一個待決策，以及一個索引的可執行選項列表，涵蓋了移動、攻擊、法術、反應、目標、準備和稀缺資源。任務是評估合法選擇的價值，這些選擇的後果依賴於行動經濟、生物特徵、戰場幾何、時機窗口和未來遭遇。DungeonBench有兩個軌道：Encounter，評估單場戰鬥中的局部戰術玩法；以及Day，通過持續的生命值、法術槽、消耗品、準備和短暫休息的時機鏈接遭遇，迫使政策在即時戰術優勢和未來生存能力之間進行權衡。同一引擎生成的決策流支持啟發式控制器、語言模型政策、學習的選項排序器和掩碼行動強化學習代理。我們在這個共享的決策流上評估前沿語言模型政策。結果顯示，完整的戰術觀察並未飽和基準：前沿政策經常在直接遭遇中獲勝，但鏈接的遭遇日則暴露出資源預算、休息時機和規則意識戰術紀律的失敗。
